/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import requests, time
pairs={
'a;i':[200192911,200200549,200151436,200154892,200150479,200150520,200150514,200122825,200108289,200121077,200102482,200103102],
'a;v':[200313792,200331111,200302612,200213155,200203450,200203449,200181134,200163978,200163975,200140452,200142170,200114768],
'a;vii':[200192904,200049593,200131403,200151436,200115987,200071073,200104214,200089311,200084117,200073569,200060146,200063739],
'c;v':[200138018,200047605],
'e;i':[200333510,200216701],
'e;v':[],
'f;v':[200210981,200119944,200114718,200051329,5225,200024671,200028340,200022409],
'h;v':[200163295,200057324,5421,200036284],
'j;v':[200212622,200148718,200101831,200075118,200068804,200070649,200058590,200058120,5665,200066945,200066944,200057846],
'k;v':[200040156,200035322],
'l;v':[200176390,200062089],
}
for pair, ids in pairs.items():
 print('\\n###',pair)
 for uid in ids[:15]:
  try:
   r=requests.post('https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi',data={'db':'gds','id':str(uid),'retmode':'json'},timeout=30)
   val=r.json()['result'].get(str(uid),{})
   print(uid, val.get('accession'), val.get('title'), '|', val.get('gdsType',''))
  except Exception as e:
   print(uid,'ERR',e)
  time.sleep(.1)
PY"
